value.title: Herangtunet Norway | Mountain Lodge Norway | Official Website
value.description: Herangtunet is a beautiful Mountain Lodge in Norway. A peaceful and  place with four beautiful suites and five comfortable rooms. Book the best rate here.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Outdoor adventures
Explore the Valdres region through hikes, skiing, or mountain biking, right from our doorstep into the beautiful Norwegian nature.
Create unforgettable moments while discovering the breathtaking beauty of the Valdres region and its mountains. From crisp winter days to golden autumns and endless summer nights. This is the essence of Herangtunet: a place where nature, adventure, and a warm feeling of home come together.
Welcome to Herangtunet, a place where you can relax, recharge, and connect with the spirit of nature.
Discover serenity and vitality seamlessly intertwined at our hotel, an inspirational environment designed for both relaxation and invigorating activities. Immerse yourself in tranquility while enjoying the great Norwegian outdoors. Embraced by the natural beauty of the nearby Jotunheimen National Park, the ski-slopes of Beitostølen, the crisp air and an infinite galaxy at night, this is a special place, a way of life we invite you to come and experience.
Herangtunet offers a serene retreat, guaranteeing a unique and unforgettable experience for those seeking rest and relaxation. With the surroundings, Herangtunet serves as the perfect place to a tranquil haven, providing an ideal setting for outdoor activities to create unique and unforgettable memories.
